Job Overview: The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.Core Responsibilities: Student Support & Intervention Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support. Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies. Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward. Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities. Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills. Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning. Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered. Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans. Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success. Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies. Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans. Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding. Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles. Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required. Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family. Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration. Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments. Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children. Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs. Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers. Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented). Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.Collaboration Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension. Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports. Monitor students’ progress and well-being. Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners. Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning. Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children. Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning. Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load. Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed. Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.Operational and Professional Conduct Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies. Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress. Maintain accurate student records. Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods. Participate in professional development opportunities. Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned. Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines. Follow theEAC Safeguarding Guide.Other duties, as assigned.Working Conditions: Walk on paths and rough terrain May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set upPOSITION REQUIREMENTS Minimum Education Required: BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent Minimum Experience Required: Five years of teaching experience, preferred Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences. Experience working in a school setting or educational environment. Specific Knowledge: Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners. Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented. Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards. Other Skills (Desirable): Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven. Collegial and collaborative. Innovative and creative. Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure. English level required: C1 or above Portuguese level required: none for teachers instructing in English C1 or above for teachers instructing in PortugueseChild Safeguarding Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

Você não entrega e some, você fica até o número fechar Elaborar DFC, DMPL e DVA em cases complexos, de empresas com demonstrações financeiras publicadas, capital aberto e fechado Aplicar CPC, IFRS e consolidação em estruturas societárias que a maioria dos profissionais nunca viu de perto, incluindo conversão de moeda e múltiplas entidades Participar das reuniões de decisão do projeto junto ao cliente, alinhado com o Coordenador. Você fala direto com controller, CFO e diretoria, e a sua leitura técnica faz diferença na conversa Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes complexos, priorizando, negociando escopo e sustentando a relação ao longo do projeto Gerenciar sua carteira de clientes complexos de ponta a ponta, com autonomia para priorizar, negociar escopo e sustentar a relação depois que o projeto vira. O cliente continua sendo seu Monitorar o risco de cada conta com método, olhando adoção da plataforma, frequência de uso, troca de interlocutor e sinais de insatisfação. Risco identificado cedo é problema resolvido, risco identificado tarde é cliente perdido Conduzir revisões periódicas com o cliente, mostrando o que a plataforma já entregou de resultado e o que ainda dá para destravar. É a conversa que renova a relação todo ciclo Identificar oportunidades de expansão dentro da conta, novas empresas do grupo, novos módulos, novos times que podem usar. Você enxerga antes porque conhece a estrutura por dentro;O que precisamos que você tenha Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas Domínio de CPC, IFRS e normas do CFC Conhecimento avançado em consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras Experiência real conduzindo projetos, não só participando deles Excel e Word em nível avançado Espanhol fluente. Requisito obrigatório , você vai conduzir reuniões e projetos nesse idioma;Por que essa vaga é diferente Tecnologia de verdade: você trabalha dentro de uma plataforma, não de uma planilha. O conhecimento técnico que você levou anos construindo vira produto, processo e escala Temas estratégicos do mercado financeiro: consolidação multiempresa, conversão de moeda, estrutura de capital, tudo o que o setor olha de perto IA aplicada a finanças: você vai estar perto do que existe de mais atual. Controle Orçamentário: Monitorar os gastos com benefícios em comparação ao orçamento local, identificando desvios e recomendando iniciativas de controle de custos sem comprometer a qualidade. Integridade dos Dados: Manter registros e documentação de benefícios de forma meticulosa, garantindo que o HRIS (Sistema de Informação de Recursos Humanos) esteja sincronizado com as bases de dados dos fornecedores. vagas.title: Promo writer (brasil)
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. vagas.title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

vagas.title: Ai operations
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Ai operations em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Liora Liora is an energy fintech: we operate distributed generation assets across Brazil and turn the savings they generate on clients' electricity bills into financial products, credit, cashback and benefits, without increasing what clients pay. Most people treat their electricity bill as a fixed, unavoidable cost, something you pay and forget. What they don't realize is that energy has all the characteristics of a financial asset: it's recurring, predictable, and present in virtually every household and business budget. Liora was built on that insight. The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved. We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors. This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents. We are looking for the person who will make it work. What you'll operate Credit & Risk Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client. Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk. Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes. Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you. Ownership Transfer Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems. Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct. Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving. Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle. These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command. Who you are We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems. You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one. Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it. You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer. You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again. Why now, why Liora The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers. We're backed by Canary, 17 Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end. You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go. The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.

Estamos ampliando nosso time e buscamos Assessores de Investimentos que já atuam no mercado e desejam encontrar uma estrutura que valorize sua autonomia, relacionamento com os clientes e potencial de crescimento. Sobre a oportunidade O profissional será responsável pela gestão do relacionamento e desenvolvimento de sua carteira de clientes, identificando necessidades, objetivos e perfil de cada cliente para apoiá-lo na tomada de decisões de investimento, sempre dentro das atribuições aplicáveis ao Assessor de Investimentos. Principais responsabilidades: Gestão do relacionamento e desenvolvimento da carteira de clientes; Prospecção e expansão da base de relacionamento; Identificação do perfil, objetivos e necessidades patrimoniais dos clientes; Apoio na construção e acompanhamento de carteiras de investimentos, observados o perfil e os objetivos do cliente e as atribuições regulatórias do Assessor de Investimentos; Acompanhamento de mercado, produtos e oportunidades de investimento; Relacionamento próximo e consultivo com os clientes; Acompanhamento periódico das carteiras e das necessidades dos clientes; Atuação em conformidade com as normas e regulamentações aplicáveis ao mercado financeiro. Requisitos Certificação ANCORD e credenciamento regular para atuação como Assessor(a) de Investimentos; Mínimo de 1 anode experiência como Assessor(a) de Investimentos; Possuir carteira ativa de clientes, independentemente do tamanho; Experiência comrelacionamento, atendimento e prospecção de clientes; Conhecimento deprodutos financeiros, investimentos, alocação de ativos e relação entre risco e retorno; Perfil comercial e capacidade de prospecção e desenvolvimento de relacionamento; Postura ética, autonomia e visão de longo prazo. Por que fazer parte da Performance Invest?Acreditamos que, para entregar uma experiência de excelência aos clientes, o assessor também precisa encontrar um ambiente que valorize seu trabalho e seu desenvolvimento. Por isso, na Performance Invest, o assessor também é tratado como cliente, contando com uma estrutura pensada para proporcionar autonomia, flexibilidade e condições competitivas para crescer. Nossos diferenciais: Modelo de trabalho flexível: 100% remoto ou híbrido, de acordo com a preferência do assessor; Flexibilidade de horários; Estrutura e suporte para desenvolvimento da carteira; Autonomia e relacionamento próximo com o escritório; Acesso ao ecossistema e às soluções da XP Investimentos. Se você já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos e procura uma estrutura para desenvolver sua carteira com mais autonomia, flexibilidade e condições competitivas, queremos conhecer você.

vagas.description:

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.Responsibilities :The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.Qualifications :BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.Required Skills :Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

About First IgniteFirst Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take researchcoming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.The roleWe're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build theevals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long andinconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that aperson reviews before anything happens with it.Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you'veshipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no ideawhether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.What you'll do• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systemsare old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expectentity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited toPromptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidencesignals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them asregression tests.• Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with promptstrategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually meansgenerating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers willeventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming toyou.Required Qualifications:• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that realusers touched.• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little abouta multi-step run.• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, andturned them into something an agent can call reliably.• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it againsta structured source of truth.• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) andwhat to do about it.• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the questionbeing asked instead of a nearby one.• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an evalfor them.• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is thefurthest east we can go.You might currently be titledAI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AIDeveloper · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AITitles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'llgo on what you've shipped.Preferred Qualifications:• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AIAgents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.Responsibilities :The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.Qualifications :BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.Required Skills :Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Um Tech Lead eficaz provê toda uma visão técnica à sua equipe de desenvolvimento e trabalha junto aos desenvolvedores para transformá-la em realidade. Ao longo do caminho, um líder técnico assumirá características inerentes a outras funções como liderança de equipe, arquitetura de software, mas permanecerá intrinsecamente ligado ao código-fonte do produtoO que você vai fazer?Liderar e inspirar desenvolvedores, incentivando a curiosidade e o engajamento com o propósito do time. Comunicar lacunas e oportunidades técnicas em linguagem acessível ao negócio. Facilitar discussões sobre trade-offs entre tecnologias e ferramentas. Fomentar uma cultura de root-cause analysis e aprendizado pós-incidente. Conectar a visão arquitetural big picture da companhia com os detalhes da arquitetura da solução. Desenhar a arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos do negócio. Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch e streaming em larga escala. Orientar desenvolvedores na otimização de jobs Spark/Flink e no uso adequado de data warehouses colunares. Definir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento.Requisitos ImprescindíveisExperiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, com histórico sólido na área, forte pensamento lógico e resolução de problemas complexos. Proficiência em linguagens de programação (Python, Java ou outras) e SQL para manipulação e gerenciamento de dados. Conhecimento em tecnologias de Big Data e processamento de grandes volumes de dados. Experiência com Sistemas de Gerenciamento de Banco de Dados (SGBD) para projetar e manter estruturas eficientes e processos críticos. Habilidade em documentação, aplicação de boas práticas de arquitetura de dados e pensamento analítico. Capacidade de monitorar custos e performance em Redshift, Big Query ou Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching. Habilidade para implementar testes de qualidade de dados e observabilidade end-to-end nos pipelines críticos.Stack DesejávelData Warehouses & Data Lakes:Redshift, Big Query, Snowflake, Athena, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake. Processamento:Spark (Data Frames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS). Ingestão & Mensageria:Apache Ni Fi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub. Orquestração & Observabilidade:Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Open Telemetry, Data Hub, Great Expectations. Infraestrutura & Qualidade:Terraform (Ia C), CI/CD (Git), testes de dados automatizados e segurança/LGPD (IAM fine-grained, criptografia em repouso e em trânsito).Benefícios OferecidosModelo 100% Remoto:Auxílio home office e a flexibilidade de trabalhar de onde estiver. Saúde e Bem-estar:Descontos em academias através do Total Pass. Incentivo aos Estudos:Reembolso total de certificações necessárias para sua atuação profissional. Programa de Indicação:Bônus de R$ 2.000,00 por indicação de novos colaboradores (\"Bears\") que permaneçam conosco por mais de 3 meses.

O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.Sobre a Oportunidade: A oportunidade está inserida em uma empresa de grande porte do setor automotivo, integrante de um ecossistema global altamente conectado à inovação, tecnologia industrial e transformação digital aplicada à manufatura. Em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado à eficiência operacional, a iniciativa busca avançar no uso de dados, Inteligência Artificial e automação para otimizar processos industriais e fortalecer a maturidade tecnológica da operação. O projeto tem como objetivo desenvolver e implementar um ecossistema inteligente de monitoramento e controle de máquinas industriais, utilizando dados históricos, estatística avançada, Inteligência Artificial, Io T e interfaces homem-máquina com foco em UX. Se você deseja aplicar pesquisa avançada em um desafio real da indústria, conectando IA, manufatura, UX, otimização de parâmetros e Indústria 4.0, este projeto oferece um ambiente estratégico para gerar impacto direto na operação industrial e contribuir com soluções inovadoras para o futuro da manufatura automotiva.Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado completo emCiência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas. Desenvolver, treinar e validar modelos de Machine Learning, estatística avançada e Inteligência Artificial para previsão de tendências de fabricação, desvios de processo e recomendação de parâmetros ótimos. Estruturar pipelines de dados para coleta, tratamento, integração, armazenamento e disponibilização de informações provenientes de máquinas, sensores, sistemas industriais e servidores de dados. Criar modelos analíticos para definição de limites de controle, redução de variabilidade de processo e apoio à tomada de decisão orientada por dados. Apoiar a construção de dashboards, indicadores e ferramentas analíticas para monitoramento contínuo de performance, qualidade, estabilidade de processo e eficiência operacional. Validar tecnicamente os resultados dos modelos desenvolvidos, avaliando acurácia, confiabilidade, escalabilidade, robustez e aplicabilidade no ambiente industrial.Requisitos Técnicos MínimosConhecimento em arquitetura de dados, integração com servidores, bancos de dados, APIs ou pipelines analíticos. vagas.title: Senior aml investigations & case specialist
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior aml investigations & case specialist em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

This role supports the MLRO in fulfilling the company's AML/CFT obligations by conducting local transaction monitoring investigations, screening reviews, case analysis, and suspicious activity assessments. The role is responsible for ensuring that investigative analysis, case documentation, and reporting recommendations are performed and maintained within Brazil in accordance with local regulatory requirements.Key Responsibilities Conduct investigations into transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions screening hits, and other financial crime cases relating to the Brazilian entity. Analyse customer activity and transaction patterns to identify suspicious activity and document investigative findings. Prepare and maintain complete investigation case files and supporting documentation. Support the MLRO in assessing and recommending suspicious transaction reports to Coaf. Perform local sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening reviews where required. Escalate complex investigations, emerging risks, and material findings to the MLRO. Maintain accurate records of investigations and case decisions for regulatory and audit purposes. Work with global AML teams to obtain supporting intelligence while retaining ownership of the local investigative assessment. Support regulatory examinations, audits, and ongoing enhancement of AML controls and monitoring processes. Requirements Brazilian citizen with the legal right to work in Brazil. Must be based in Brazil 3–5 years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, financial crime investigations, or compliance within a regulated financial institution, fintech, payment institution, or cryptocurrency exchange. Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, suspicious transaction reporting, and financial crime typologies. Experience with transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening, and case management tools. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Embraces AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline compliance processes, and enhance the quality of regulatory analysis and decision-making. Profile Strong analytical and investigative judgement with excellent attention to detail. Able to make sound, risk-based decisions independently while maintaining high standards of documentation. Collaborative, hands-on, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment. Passionate about cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and the evolving digital asset ecosystem, with a genuine curiosity to stay ahead of industry and regulatory developments.

A Agro Busca está recebendo solicitações de clientes de várias regiões do Brasil e está formando um time de parceiros apaixonados pelo agronegócio, por tecnologia e por ajudar pessoas. Procuramos alguém com iniciativa, boa comunicação e vontade de representar a Agro Busca na sua cidade ou região. Não buscamos apenas alguém para vender. Buscamos um parceiro capaz de ouvir, entender a realidade de cada cliente e construir relacionamentos duradouros. O que você fará Como Parceiro(a) de Negócios Agro Busca, você atuará no desenvolvimento de novos negócios e no relacionamento com clientes e parceiros do setor agro. Acompanhará as oportunidades desde o primeiro contato até a conclusão da negociação, sempre buscando entender as necessidades do mercado e oferecer soluções adequadas ao portfólio da empresa. No dia a dia, suas principais atividades serão: Prospectar e desenvolver novos clientes e parceiros no setor agro. Identificar demandas e oportunidades na sua cidade ou região. Apresentar as soluções da Agro Busca de forma consultiva e clara. Participar de negociações e acompanhar cada oportunidade até a conclusão. Cultivar relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes e parceiros. Acompanhar os resultados comerciais e contribuir para a satisfação dos envolvidos. Mapear regiões, culturas e segmentos prioritários. Apoiar ações comerciais, relacionamento e marketing. Compartilhar percepções do mercado e sugestões para aprimorar produtos e serviços. O que esperamos de você Estamos procurando uma pessoa comunicativa, responsável e com espírito de parceria. Alguém que goste de conversar, tenha facilidade para criar vínculos e entenda que, no agro, cada região tem sua realidade e merece ser tratada com atenção. É importante ter: Experiência com vendas, desenvolvimento de negócios, representação comercial ou parcerias. Vivência no agronegócio ou em segmentos relacionados. Conhecer produtores, cooperativas, revendas, empresas de insumos ou outros participantes da cadeia será um diferencial. Boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e habilidade para apresentar propostas de valor. Perfil consultivo, com capacidade de ouvir, compreender necessidades e propor soluções. Organização, autonomia e disciplina para trabalhar de forma remota. Facilidade com ferramentas digitais, como videoconferência, CRM, planilhas e aplicativos de comunicação. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário sobre o mercado agro, suas culturas, canais de distribuição e dinâmica comercial. Formação e disponibilidade Formação em Administração, Agronegócios, Gestão Comercial, Marketing ou áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial, mas valorizamos principalmente a experiência prática, o conhecimento regional e a capacidade de construir bons relacionamentos. Também é desejável ter disponibilidade para eventuais viagens, reuniões presenciais com clientes e participação em eventos do setor. Modelo de atuação

Temos orgulho de oferecer soluções tecnológicas integradas, inovadoras, confiáveis e inteligentes para o mercado de rastreamento seguro. Nosso negócio está alicerçado em parcerias sólidas e estratégicas com empresas líderes em seus diversos segmentos, a partir do desenvolvimento de alternativas sob medida, que protegem a sociedade de fraudes e falsificaçõe s.    Acreditamos que a inclusão fortalece nossa equipe e enriquece nossas soluções, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho mais diversificado e inclusivo. Sendo assim, todas as nossas vagas são extensivas a pessoas com deficiência (Pc D).    Estamos com oportunidad e para TÉCNICO DE OPERAÇÕES . vagas.title: Senior asset & material management specialist
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior asset & material management specialist em guarulhos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT SHEIN SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future! ABOUT THE ROLE Responsible for the end-to-end management of company assets and materials, including inventory control, maintenance, recycling, disposal, and system operations, ensuring asset security, compliance, and efficient utilization. Job Responsibilities: Manage the inbound and outbound flow of materials; verify that material name codes, quantities, and specifications match system records and purchase orders; establish asset cards in a timely manner to ensure alignment between physical items, records, and system entries. Review and oversee the recycling of materials and the optimal allocation of idle resources. Track material maintenance activities, assign maintenance personnel, monitor maintenance progress, and collect and analyze maintenance data. Review and handle scrapped materials and commodities according to company procedures; ensure proper disposal of such items. Provide guidance and supervision on departmental material and asset management; ensure the implementation of asset management responsibilities at the individual level; manage recovery and compensation in cases of material damage or loss. Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above; at least 5 years of experience in asset management or administrative management is preferred. Familiar with asset management processes; proficient in asset management systems and computer operations, especially MS Office (Word, Excel, etc.). Solid knowledge of asset management, including asset definition, classification, management methods, and understanding of the asset lifecycle concept. At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

vagas.title: Líder de expedição
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Líder de expedição em arujá. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

A Roeslein Brasil abrange mais de 9.000 metros quadrados e é responsável pela fabricação de uma série de equipamentos especializados, incluindo transportadores, sistemas de biogás, skids de petróleo e gás e soluções industriais modulares. A equipe de São Paulo possui expertise profissional em uma ampla gama de serviços avançados de manufatura, incluindo corte a laser, prensagem, soldagem e sistemas de pintura eletrostática.      Se você se identifica com o nosso ethos – ser sempre humilde, estar sempre disposto e feliz – confira a vaga disponível abaixo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!      Atuação: 100% Presencial    Região de Atuação: Arujá/SP    Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à sexta-feira das 06h às 15h48 (com 1h para refeição)    Modelo de Trabalho: CLT      RESUMO DA POSIÇÃ O:    O Líder de Expedição será responsável por fornecer suporte de documentação e envio das peças produzidas pela Roeslein. Essa posição também conduzirá a equipe responsável pela fabricação dos paletes (crates) utilizados para enviar nossos equipamentos aos clientes, o que inclui supervisão direta e coordenação de atividades com forte ênfase em práticas de trabalho seguras.      DEVERES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS: Fornecer liderança à equipe, administrar suas cargas de trabalho, fornecer suporte para garantir entregas no prazo, monitorar quaisquer problemas e garantir que metas de produção, com Indicadores de Desempenho Chave (KPIs) e padrões de qualidade, sejam atendidos para atender às exigências do cliente. Orientar e treinar a equipe para garantir as embalagens (crates) dentro dos padrões de qualidade. Seguir as ordens de produção e planejamento para garantir as entregas dentro do prazo. Garantir que todas as peças saiam da empresa devidamente identificadas e com o rastreamento necessário, inclusive com fotos de qualidade. Trabalhar em colaboração com os líderes dos outros setores para garantir a entrega de 100% dos itens. Início das reuniões de turno garantindo uma comunicação efetiva de todos os elementos das placas de KPI e do plano de produção diário. Conduzir-se como agente da Liderança da Roeslein, sempre representando os objetivos e políticas da empresa de forma positiva e profissional, liderando pelo exemplo. Desenvolver e manter o sistema de rastreamento de documentos para projetos. Auxiliar no transporte, bem como acompanhar todos os conteúdos de um projeto. Fornecer documentação de envio por especificações do projeto. Gerar documentos de envio, por exemplo, listas de embalagem, (PL, BOL, PDIs etc..). Conduzir com a equipe do projeto para garantir que todos os itens estejam preparados para o envio e capacidade de usar o Connex, Roes Trac & Viewpoint enviados ao local a tempo e ordenadamente. Conduzir com departamentos apropriados em itens faltantes e/ou status para garantir que as datas de envio também sejam atendidas. Inserir detalhes para adesivos no desenho. Realizar atividades de forma segura e saudável e trabalhar de acordo com as exigências estabelecidas de segurança e empresa.    CONHECIMENTO / HABILIDADE / EDUCAÇÃ O / EXPERIÊ NCIA: Ensino Superior na área industrial. Desejável: 5 (cinco) anos de experiência em expedição ou campo relacionado. Capacidade de interpretar desenhos detalhados de design de engenharia. Capacidade de desenvolver e organizar a documentação de envio para envios de saída PLs.    BENEFÍ CIOS      Na Roeslein, investimos no sucesso e no bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores. Abaixo estão os benefícios oferecidos:     Assistência médica (cobertura apartamento) e odontológica Seguro de Vida Vale refeição/alimentação (R$60,00 por dia útil) Auxílio-pedágio (R$ 210,00 por mês) Incentivos para educação, com reembolsos para cursos de idiomas, cursos técnicos, graduações e especializações Incentivos para saúde física, com totalpass, reembolsos anuais de academia e reembolsos por corridas de ruas Programa de bônus Gratificação em viagens corporativas

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Analista de revenue operations - revops em florianópolis. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Visão Geral da Vaga   ⚙️ Quem costura marketing e vendas numa máquina só    Hoje marketing gera demanda e vendas converte — mas o dado entre os dois se perde no caminho. O Rev Ops é quem fecha esse elo: unifica a leitura do funil ponta a ponta, transforma número em decisão e constrói as alavancas que fazem os dois times venderem mais.      O Analista de Revenue Operations é responsável pela eficiência da máquina de receita como um todo — do primeiro clique de mídia ao contrato assinado. Ele é dono do CRM, da camada de dados e das automações que conectam Marketing, Pré-vendas, Vendas e CS, garantindo que a liderança enxergue o funil inteiro com números confiáveis.      Mas essa cadeira não é de manutenção. Não queremos alguém que apenas ajuste processo e limpe base: queremos quem identifica gargalos, propõe e constrói soluções — dashboards, automações, agentes de IA, rotinas de roteamento e scoring — que viram alavanca real de resultado para vendas e marketing.      Estamos dispostos a treinar quem vier com a mentalidade certa. O que não negociamos: raciocínio analítico, organização, proatividade e vontade de aplicar IA de verdade numa operação em crescimento acelerado.      Sobre a Empresa    Nossa Missão    Acelerar o Brasil com Inteligência Artificial    Nossa Visão    Acelerar 10 mil empresas com IA até 2030      Nossos Valores    Lealdade    Construímos relações de longo prazo — com clientes, colegas e parceiros.    Postura de Dono    Agimos como donos do negócio, com responsabilidade e protagonismo.    Diversão e Desafio    Acreditamos que crescer e se divertir não são opostos.    Investimento em Crescimento    Evoluímos as pessoas que escolhem crescer conosco.   ⚡ Agilidade 80/20    Focamos no que gera mais resultado com menos desperdício.   ✨ Encantamento    Superamos expectativas — de clientes, candidatos e time.    Responsabilidades & Entregas    Integração Marketing + Vendas Unificar a leitura do funil ponta a ponta — da origem da mídia ao contrato fechado — com definições de estágio, nomenclatura e critérios de qualificação compartilhados entre os times. Garantir rastreabilidade completa de origem do lead (UTMs, campanhas, canais) até a receita, para que marketing saiba o que gera venda e vendas saiba o que está recebendo. Operar o SLA entre marketing e vendas: volume e qualidade de MQLs, tempo de resposta, taxa de aceite e devolução de leads. Ser o ponto neutro na mesa quando os times divergem sobre qualidade de lead ou performance — trazendo dado, não opinião.    Dados, Visibilidade e Decisão Construir e manter os dashboards de receita da operação — funil, conversão por etapa, CAC, ciclo de vendas, forecast e performance individual. Garantir a integridade dos dados no CRM: higienização, deduplicação, regras de preenchimento obrigatório e auditoria recorrente. Transformar dado em recomendação: identificar gargalos, quantificar o impacto e levar à liderança o que precisa ser decidido — com hipótese e plano de ação. Preparar os números das rituais da operação: reunião de forecast, passada de receita e reportes para a diretoria.    Construção de Alavancas Projetar e implementar automações que eliminem trabalho manual do time comercial e de marketing — roteamento de leads, cadências, notificações, atualizações de CRM e handoffs entre áreas. Criar e evoluir soluções aplicadas de IA para a operação: qualificação assistida, scoring de leads, sumarização de calls, enriquecimento de base e apoio à priorização de pipeline. Prototipar rápido, medir o resultado e decidir com clareza o que escala e o que é descartado — sem se apegar à própria construção. Documentar processos e treinar os times nas ferramentas e rotinas criadas, garantindo adoção real e não só entrega técnica.    O Que Esperamos de Você    Requisitos 2 a 5 anos de experiência em Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, BI ou growth com foco em receita. Domínio de ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Metabase, Looker Studio, Power BI ou equivalentes) — capaz de construir dashboard do zero, não apenas consumir. Experiência prática com ferramentas de automação low-code (n8n, Make, Zapier) — construindo fluxos que rodam em produção. Vivência como administrador de CRM (Pipedrive, Hub Spot, Clint ou similar): campos, funis, permissões, integrações e relatórios. Entendimento do funil comercial B2 B completo: geração de demanda, pré-vendas, closing e pós-venda.    Diferenciais Valorizados SQL para consultas em base própria. Experiência construindo agentes ou fluxos com IA generativa aplicados a operação comercial. Vivência em Edtech, infoproduto ou operação de vendas de alto volume. Passagem por startup em hypergrowth, onde o processo foi construído e não herdado.    Perfil Comportamental Tem postura de dono — não espera briefing pronto; enxerga o problema, formula a hipótese e traz a solução. É builder por natureza: fica incomodado com trabalho manual repetitivo e resolve construindo, não reclamando. Pensa em negócio antes de pensar em ferramenta — entende que dashboard bonito sem decisão tomada é desperdício. Transita bem entre marketing e vendas sem tomar partido; ganha confiança dos dois lados pela consistência do dado. Aprende rápido e aplica imediatamente — a curva de IA é rápida e ele/ela acompanha. Equilibra rigor e velocidade: entrega o 80/20 que destrava o time hoje, sem abrir mão da confiabilidade do número.    O Que Oferecemos Autonomia real para desenhar a operação de receita de uma empresa em crescimento acelerado — cadeira nova, com espaço para deixar digital próprio. Acesso direto à liderança comercial e à diretoria: seu trabalho vira decisão na mesma semana. Plano de carreira estruturado em 5 níveis, com regras claras de progressão. Acesso completo à plataforma de cursos e trilhas de IA — você se torna referência no tema. Orçamento e liberdade para testar ferramentas: aqui IA não é promessa, é ferramenta do dia a dia. Ambiente de alta performance, com cultura de feedback contínuo, celebração de resultado e diversão no caminho.

Experiência prévia comprovada em revisão de código e desenvolvimento seguro “mão na massa”. Conhecimento em PCI-DSS e nas resoluções BACEN 4.658/4.893 e regulações bancárias. vagas.title: Remote privacy lawyer - brazil
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Remote privacy lawyer - brazil em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

S. companies with exceptional remote professionals throughout Latin America and the Caribbean. S.-based companies where English is the primary working language , so you must be fully comfortable conducting interviews, evaluating candidates’ English communication skills, writing professional candidate summaries, and communicating confidently with internal stakeholders and clients in English.      This is not a role where you’ll simply post jobs and review applications. You'll manage multiple searches simultaneously, actively source candidates, screen and assess talent, maintain organized recruiting pipelines, and partner closely with our internal team to ensure we’re consistently presenting strong candidates to our clients.      We’re especially interested in someone who knows how to use AI, recruiting technology, automation, ATS platforms (Zoho Recruit), and CRMs to work smarter and make recruiting processes more efficient. You should also be able to identify bottlenecks throughout the recruitment process and recommend practical ways to improve efficiency, candidate flow, and overall hiring outcomes.    Because Remotely+ is growing, you'll also have the opportunity to help us improve, build, and refine recruiting processes as we scale.      What You'll Do Manage multiple recruiting searches simultaneously across different industries and job functions. Source candidates through Linked In, job boards, databases, referrals, social media, and creative sourcing strategies. Review and screen high volumes of applications efficiently while maintaining strong hiring standards. Conduct initial candidate interviews and assess experience, communication skills, English proficiency, professionalism, and overall fit. Evaluate candidates against client requirements and identify the strongest profiles to move forward. Prepare candidate summaries, recruiter notes, and recommendations for internal and client review. Maintain accurate candidate records, stages, notes, communications, and activity within the ATS. Proactively build talent pipelines for frequently hired and hard-to-fill positions. Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process and provide a positive, responsive candidate experience. Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and recommend ways to improve efficiency. Help develop recruiting templates, screening processes, interview guides, assessments, workflows, and standard operating procedures as the company scales. Use AI and automation tools to increase productivity while maintaining human judgment and high recruiting standards.    What We're Looking For 3+ years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience , ideally within staffing, BPO, recruitment agencies, outsourcing, or other high-volume hiring environments. Excellent written and spoken English. Proven experience managing multiple roles and large candidate pipelines at the same time . Experience recruiting talent throughout Latin America .  ATS experience is a must and familiarity with Zoho Recruit as an ATS is a huge plus. Experience working in a staffing or recruitment agency environment.  Experience recruiting for a variety of positions and adapting quickly to unfamiliar industries or job functions. Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills. Ability to quickly identify whether a candidate truly meets the core requirements of a position. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to prioritize effectively and work independently in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working with recruiting metrics and using data to improve sourcing and hiring decisions. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
